name: powershell-watchdog
description: Per-window memory watchdog for VS Code on Windows, Linux and macOS: monitors the processes of this window (terminals, language servers, tools) through config files and profiles, alerts on high memory, and restarts a target only through its own command.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, configs located inside a workspace folder are loaded as notify-only: they never run a restart command automatically.

commands.title: Memory Watchdog: Restart Editor Services Session…

Memory Watchdog: Copy a Built-in Config to My Folder…

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.enabled.description: Monitor the processes of this VS Code window selected by the active profile.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.mode.markdownDescription: Global kill switch. `notifyOnly` disables every automatic restart, whatever the configs say. `automatic` lets a config restart its target when its own rules, approval and workspace trust allow it.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.sampleInterva.description: Delay between completed collections, in seconds.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.collectTimeou.description: Maximum time for one process collection, in seconds.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.historyRetent.description: Retain workspace history across VS Code sessions for this many days.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.historyMaxMiB.description: Combined on-disk history budget in MiB.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.reportRetenti.description: Age limit for owned exported HTML reports.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.reportMaxMiB.description: Combined HTML report storage budget in MiB.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.workload.markdownDescription: Threshold multiplier for configs with `scaleWithWorkload` (default): development ×1, tests ×1.5, build ×2.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.configPaths.markdownDescription: Extra folders containing `*.watchdog.json` configs, loaded after the built-ins and `~/.frenchexdev/memory-watchdog/`, in order; on a name collision the last one wins. Absolute paths only; `~`, `${userHome}` and `${env:NAME}` are expanded. `${workspaceFolder}` and relative paths are rejected.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.profiles.markdownDescription: Named profiles: each is a list of config names. The built-in `default` profile is `["pwsh-editor-services", "pwsh-terminals", "pwsh-children"]`; defining `default` here replaces it.

frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.activeProfile.markdownDescription: Profile monitored in every window: a built-in profile (`default`, `powershell-full`, `minimal`, `dotnet`, `web`) or one of `#frenchexdev.memoryWatchdog.profiles#`. An unknown name falls back to `default` with automatic restarts disabled.

frenchexdev.powershellWatchdog.enabled.description: Monitor pwsh instances launched by this VS Code window, its terminals and their child processes.
